Results day and your next steps

If you currently have an offer to study at King’s, you will see the status of your offer on UCAS Hub. If your place is confirmed, congratulations! You do not need to call or contact King's to secure your place. Simply enjoy your celebrations and wait for us to send you further information about enrolment and starting with us in September. Our Clearing phone line is now closed. If you received an offer through Clearing and have any questions, you can contact the Admissions Office through King's Apply. Alternatively, you can find out more about confirmation, being released from King's into Clearing and information for offer holders on our below webpages.
